```yaml
name: Fix Dependabot Security Vulnerabilities

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'   # run daily at 02:00 UTC
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-go:
    name: Update Go dependencies
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: backend/services/bulkdata/http/go.mod
      - name: Upgrade Go modules
        run: |
          cd backend/services/bulkdata/http
          go get golang.org/x/crypto@v0.45.0
          go get golang.org/x/sys@v0.38.0
          go mod tidy
      - name: Commit Go changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No Go changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "chore: update Go dependencies for security fixes"
            git push
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  update-npm:
    name: Update npm dependencies
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq
      - name: Upgrade npm modules
        run: |
          # SocketIO workspace
          cd backend/services/utils/socketio
          npm install express@4.22.1
          # Add overrides for qs and body-parser
          jq '.overrides = {"qs":"^6.14.2","body-parser":"^1.20.4"}' package.json > tmp.json && mv tmp.json package.json
          npm install
          cd ../../..
          # Frontend workspace
          cd frontend
          npm install next@15.5.12 koa@3.0.3 js-yaml@4.1.1 eslint@8.57.1 eslint-config-next@15.5.12
          # Add placeholder overrides (replace with actual safe versions)
          jq '.overrides = {"some-package":"^1.2.3"}' package.json > tmp.json && mv tmp.json package.json
          npm install
          cd ..
      - name: Commit npm changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No npm changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "chore: update npm dependencies for security fixes"
            git push
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
